title: Canonical finite constant scalar model data
statement: For a commutative topological ring $A$ and a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-size-convention] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define the scalar realization functor $\operatorname{scalarModules}_A$ on $A$-modules, the canonical constant-to-continuous scalar map $\operatorname{scalarToContinuous}_A$, and the local model functor $\operatorname{modelFunctor}_{A,T}$ obtained by constant sheafification, extension of scalars, and inverse image from the point. For a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], also define the continuous coefficient rings $\operatorname{integralCoefficients}_{\ell,E}$ and $\operatorname{rationalCoefficients}_{\ell,E}$ and their canonical model functors $\operatorname{integralModel}_{\ell,E,T}$ and $\operatorname{rationalModel}_{\ell,E,T}$.
